thread:
Keiko Tanaka: Hey folks! Keiko here — starting today on Eng Docs. :wave: I'm based in SF, love sushi (can't resist a good unagi), have a desk plant obsession (count is now 7), and I'm learning ukulele. Super excited to join!

Matt Rivera: welcome Keiko!! :tada: Unagi is the hill I will die on too.

Olivia Park: hi Keiko — welcome! There's a sushi lunch group that meets Friday ~12:30, you should join. Also plant swap on Thursdays in the lounge :seedling:

Keiko Tanaka: omg yes to both. Where's the lounge exactly? and how do I RSVP for lunch?

Juno Li: Welcome!!! The lounge is on 3rd floor next to the kitchen. For lunch just DM @olivia or add your name to the #lunch-plan thread, but tbh we usually just show up. :shrug:

Anne (People Ops): Hi Keiko, welcome aboard! Your badge is at reception and HR has you in the onboarding doc. If you need a parking pass or anything, ping me. Also there's a welcome kit with a plant starter pack — bring a pot if you'd like one. :gift_heart:

Keiko Tanaka: Amazing, thank you Anne! Where's the onboarding doc?

Anne (People Ops): https://ourdocs.redwood/onboarding/keiko — I'll add you to the doc shortly and schedule a quick 3pm buddy chat with Matt. :coffee:

Matt Rivera: I brought mini succulents yesterday if you want one for your desk (3B-12 is a good spot for sun).

Olivia Park: quick poll — which cuisine do we bribe Keiko with this week?
1) Sushi :sushi:
2) Ramen :ramen:
3) Bagels :bagel:
Reply with the number.

Keiko Tanaka: 1! Sushi wins (though ramen is a close second) :sushi:

welcome-bot: Keiko added to #new-hires, #eng, and #lunch-plan. :robot_face: Feel free to ask any onboarding q's here or DM Anne/your buddy.

Juno Li: also extremely important: coffee or tea? :thinking_face:

Keiko Tanaka: Coffee, black please.

Matt Rivera: noted. See you at 3pm for the quick intro chat — bringing a tiny succulent as a peace offering. :seedling:
